title: mangifera zeylanica
intro: Mangifera zeylanica, commonly known as Ceylon satinwood, is a species of evergreen tree native to Sri Lanka. It is valued for its timber, which is used in furniture-making and carpentry due to its durability and attractive grain pattern. The health benefits of Mangifera zeylanica include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health, likely due to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
